THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
042
STUDY 025
Cream Shearling & Striped Top
Rights check
Source: 24572.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long dark hair wears a
cream shearling bonnet and a matching
shearling-trimmed jacket. Under it, a brown and cream
striped top with a lace hem and a gold cross pendant.
She holds one arm up beside an open car door, and
her expression is confident and a little playful. Snowy
hills and a vivid blue sky stretch behind her. Bright,
crisp sunlight, a palette of cream, camel, and cobalt
blue. Playful and bold, in the style of a street-style
winter lookbook.
Playful, cozy, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The shearling textures and striped top are the signature
details.
- Keep the raised arm for a dynamic pose.
